caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a horse-drawn fire engine with two human figures riding it. The composition shows two brown horses harnessed side by side, running and attached to a carriage. The carriage consists of two large, spoked, brown wheels at the front and rear, supporting a structure that includes a large brass or bronze steam boiler, a water pump, and various mechanical components and pipes. At the front of the carriage, a person wearing a hat and uniform is seated and holding reins, controlling the horses. Toward the back, another person in similar attire and a helmet is seated behind the machinery. The drawing features mostly brown and beige tones, with the metallic parts rendered in shades of bronze and gray. The background is plain, light beige, with no additional scenery or elements. There are also dark, curved pipes or supports extending downward from the carriage, possibly representing mechanical or structural components.
title: Weather Vane: Model Fire Engine
